method: Opened primary sources with web browsing; located rules used by the chapter. The original UCI Fielding URL timed out; the author's roy.gbiv.com copy was opened instead.

sources.supports: REST constraints, stateless interactions and uniform interface rather than JSON as the definition.
Safe/idempotent methods, conditional requests and 304 semantics; application operation keys are not supplied by HTTP.
Authenticated shared-reuse exceptions, Vary, validation updates and private; chapter shared-cache policy is deliberately stricter.
Four RPC shapes, final status and no rollback of previously applied changes on cancellation.
Explicit deadline, application cooperation with cancellation, propagated remaining timeout with elapsed time deducted.
Browser gRPC-Web generated client and proxy adaptation; no assertion that arbitrary fetch supports every native streaming shape.
Deleted field numbers must be reserved; names should be reserved for JSON/TextFormat compatibility. Semantic compatibility still needs application review.
HTTP/1.1 Upgrade/101, Origin and Ping/Pong control frames; no business durability acknowledgement is defined.
HTTP/2 Extended CONNECT and successful 2xx response rather than universally requiring 101.
EventSource GET/API limits, UTF-8 framing, automatic last-event-ID state, reconnect/204 and parser behavior. Application durable cursor, retention and RESET are explicit chapter contracts.

Per-stream order, path validation and migration constraints. In 9.5, sending from multiple local addresses must not reuse a CID; a retained QUIC connection does not imply a fixed CID. Passive NAT rebinding is separately qualified.
TCP HOL motivation, QPACK dependency and recommended TCP-based HTTP fallback on UDP connectivity failure.

Absent other knowledge unsafe/unknown-safety methods are not sent early. Forwarders must retain existing Early-Data and add it when required. A marked prior-hop risk is not erased by completing this hop's handshake. A 425 retry is not early data. Gateway early forwarding requires known origin support.
HTTP :status 200 and grpc-status are separate; final RPC status is required and may be trailers-only.
The browser JavaScript WebSocket API does not directly expose Ping/Pong frames.
Streaming write return can mean framework acceptance before actual network transmission, motivating an explicit bounded-adapter contract.

teachingAssumptions: A1–A12 are chapter inputs, not measurements or provider guarantees. Java verifies local policy; SQLite verifies one client's transaction only. No live message log, model, TLS proxy or QUIC impaired-network experiment was run.
